# Kelvin Maro U. — AI Product Engineer & Founder of RUVIN IT Consulting

> "I build intelligent, practical software that solves organizational and societal problems"

## Summary
Kelvin Maro U. is an AI Product Engineer based in Lagos, Nigeria, working with clients remotely worldwide. He combines 1 year of experience building AI-assisted products with 4 years of experience as an IT Support Expert. He manages IT operations for a specialist cancer hospital in Lagos (Marcelle Ruth Cancer Centre & Specialist Hospital - MRCC), supporting 100+ staff, and independently builds web platforms, internal tools, and AI-assisted workflows through his consultancy, **RUVIN IT Consulting**.

## Core Specialties & Services (RUVIN IT Consulting)
- **AI Workflow Automation**: Connecting everyday business and clinical tools with intelligent automation to eliminate repetitive manual work.
- **Building AI Agents to Optimize Organizational Workflow**: Designing and deploying custom AI agents tailored to organizational processes.
- **Healthcare IT & Systems Consulting**: Practical hospital IT operations setup, reliability auditing, and clinical/administrative technology support.
- **Custom Web & Internal Tools**: Full-stack HR portals, operational dashboards, and booking platforms built with React, Next.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.
- **Website Design, Management & Support**: Multi-site WordPress ecosystems and modern web rebuilds with ongoing technical maintenance.
